tests.name: setup-world
tests.description: Puts tester beside andy in creative and locks the world to clear daytime. Also proves tester can run commands (cheats on).

tests.name: follow
tests.description: Chat "andy follow me", tester walks 12 blocks east; andy must start following and end within 5 blocks of tester, having moved 6+ blocks.

tests.name: craft-wooden-pickaxe
tests.description: Andy with only 3 oak logs is asked in chat for a wooden pickaxe: he makes planks, sticks, a crafting table and the pickaxe.

tests.name: craft-stone-pickaxe
tests.description: With 2 oak logs, 3 cobblestone and a crafting table, chat "andy make a stone pickaxe".

tests.name: craft-furnace
tests.description: With 8 cobblestone and a crafting table, chat "andy make a furnace".

tests.name: gather-logs
tests.description: Andy with only a wooden axe is asked in chat for 4 logs: the craft loop gathers them from the nearest tree (any wood) and picks them up.

tests.name: home-chest-sign
tests.description: A chest 3 blocks east with a sign saying andy beside it. Starting a farm job makes andy look for a signed chest and adopt it. Andy looks for the home chest only once the farm loop runs, so the test runs at the farm site (water close by) and gives him a hoe and seeds; at a dry spot the job stops at "No water near here" first. Only works while andy has NO home chest saved (a fresh start with load_memory false), so it runs before the other home chest tests.

setup.note: independent of earlier tests: fresh terrain and no saved home chest

action.waitReply: Found my name on a sign

checks.match: chest at {x+3} {y} {z} is my home chest

tests.name: home-chest-command
tests.description: A chest 3 blocks east of andy, tester beside it; !setHomeChest from tester saves that chest.

tests.name: home-chest-chat
tests.description: A chest 3 blocks west of andy, tester beside it; chat "andy this is your chest" (command model: home → !setHomeChest, reply "That's my chest now."); andy then remembers home_chest at that chest.

action.waitReply: my chest now|Home chest set at

checks.match: That's my chest now|Home chest set at {x-3} {y} {z}
checks.note: the command model's home command replies "That's my chest now."; !setHomeChest run by the LLM prints the other line

checks.name: home_chest
checks.note: the chest itself must be saved: a reply alone doesn't count

tests.name: come
tests.description: Tester stands 10 blocks east of andy and chats "andy come here" (command model: come → goToPlayer, reply "On my way."); andy walks over once and says "You have reached tester.", ending within 3 blocks.

tests.name: give
tests.description: Andy holds 5 coal, tester 4 blocks east chats "andy give me 3 coal" (command model: give → givePlayer); andy tosses exactly 3 (never twice), keeps 2, says "tester received coal.", and tester's pack has 3 coal.

setup.note: the before snapshot must see the 5 coal (andy's state lags the /give)

action.waitReply: received coal|never received|only have|too close|do not have

action.note: count 0 only counts: the server replies "Found 3 matching item(s)"

tests.name: store
tests.description: A chest 3 blocks east of andy; andy holds 10 dirt, 20 cobblestone and a stone pickaxe. Tester chats "andy store everything" (command model: store, no item → one putInChest per stack, tools kept); the chest gains exactly 10 dirt and 20 cobblestone, andy says "Successfully put" and keeps the pickaxe. The chest is removed afterwards.

setup.note: the before snapshot must see the given items

action.waitReply: Successfully put 20 cobblestone|Could not|Nothing to store|do not have
action.note: not waitFor action: both deposits can finish inside one state poll

tests.name: farm-water
tests.description: A 9x9 grass patch around andy with a row of 7 ripe wheat on wet farmland 2 blocks south and a water source beside it; andy has a hoe and 16 seeds. Chat "andy farm wheat 5": he harvests 5 wheat and stops.

checks.note: the farm job's own count line, not any mention of harvesting

tests.name: farm-no-water
tests.description: Andy on a 9x9 grass platform at Y 300 (no water within 64 blocks), a hoe and seeds, no bucket or iron. !layaFarm("wheat", 5) must stop with "No water near here".

checks.note: the farm job looked for water and found none (not some other stop)

tests.name: farm-bucket
tests.description: The same dry sky platform, but andy has a water bucket: he digs a pond and pours the water in (a farm log pond step with outcome done, and water within 6 blocks of him afterwards) instead of giving up.

checks.note: a pond attempt that failed doesn't count
the pond's water is really there (no water within 64 of the platform before)

tests.name: mine-coal
tests.description: Chat "andy go mine coal 5" with a stone pickaxe, torches and bread: he ends with 5+ more coal. (Coal unloaded into a home chest doesn't show in his inventory.)

setup.note: independent of earlier tests: fresh terrain and no saved home chest

tests.name: mine-iron-staircase
tests.description: !layaMine("iron", 12) with the v2 mine plan, in two phases. The mine site has 7 iron ore within 16 blocks of the entrance (3 at the surface about 11 away, 4 at y 61-62 about 15 away; 13 within 24), far fewer than 12. (a) He collects the iron he can see first (2+ collect steps; 2 surface ore are within collect_range 12 of the stair cell) in laya-mine before the first `down` step. (b) Then, still short, he follows the plan: the "iron mine starts at" announcement, 4+ `down` staircase steps done and his Y 4+ below the start. (c) raw_iron reaches 12. The timeout allows the staircase from Y 74 to the iron band (Y 24) and some branch mining.

setup.note: independent of earlier tests: fresh terrain and no saved home chest

checks.note: phase (a): the iron in sight is collected before the staircase starts (2 surface ore lie within collect_range 12 of the stair cell)
phase (b): staircase steps, not just collecting ore in reach
phase (c): more than the visible ore gives, so the plan is needed

tests.name: unload-home-chest
tests.description: A home chest 3 blocks east set with !setHomeChest; andy's pack is filled with 31 stacks of cobblestone (2 slots free), then !layaMine("coal", 20) (more than the coal in sight: the mine's collect-first rule takes ore in sight while the pack has room, so with 2 the job could end before any Unload; 5.2): he walks home and empties the cobblestone into the chest until it is full (27 stacks; he keeps 32 and the rest stays in his pack). Fails 30 s after andy's job ends if he hasn't unloaded (no waiting out the 10-minute wait).

setup.note: independent of earlier tests: fresh terrain and no saved home chest

action.note: one chest holds 27 stacks (1728): from 1984 andy is left with at least 256, so the old max 200 could never be met

tests.name: defend
tests.description: Andy follows tester; a husk (a zombie that doesn't burn in the locked daytime) is summoned 5 blocks east of him and hits him (a /damage by the husk: beside creative tester a husk often attacks nobody, and since 2026-11-11 andy only fights a mob that attacks him or a player). He must kill it and go back to following (the interrupted job resumes). Sets difficulty easy.

checks.note: no husk within 48 blocks: it died, not just wandered out of andy's sight
a defence mode or fight action; any other mode (item_collecting…) doesn't count

tests.name: eat
tests.description: Andy has 8 bread and a strong hunger effect drains his food; when it falls he eats (auto-eat or the Laya eat model): bread goes down and food ends 15+.

checks.note: his food went up after he got hungry

tests.name: chores-idle-start
tests.description: Chores on and nothing to do: within 5 s of being idle andy asks for a chore (laya-chores.jsonl, rules until a chores model is served) and runs it as a job of kind chore.

tests.name: chores-command-interrupt
tests.description: Andy is doing a chore; tester says "andy come here" 10 blocks away. The chore stops at once and he comes (goToPlayer within 3 s, including the command model), and no chore starts while the player's job runs.

tests.name: chores-defend-player
tests.description: Andy is doing a chore; tester (survival, resistance II so it survives) stands 12 blocks away and a husk is summoned beside tester. The director answers defend (rule defend-player, v1.2), andy goes to tester and kills the husk, then goes back to chores.

tests.name: chores-no-trees
tests.description: Every log within about 30 blocks of andy (the base's chest is his centre, 8 blocks off) is removed and he has no wood. His chore is gather_logs with Near trees 97 (or 193): he says he's going further for wood and comes back with logs. The leaves go too (decaying leaves would drop saplings, and replanting comes first in the spec).

tests.name: chores-first-day
tests.description: A fresh reset, andy with nothing, the daylight cycle on from sunrise: one Minecraft day (20 minutes) of chores. The report shows how far he got (table, tools, farm, furnace, torches, chest, beds, kit); the checks ask only for the first steps (a table and wooden tools).

tests.name: defend-fight
tests.description: The defend scenario without its follow job (the new bot has no follow job until 4.2): a husk 5 blocks east of andy hits him (/damage by the husk). The director answers defend, andy kills the husk and frees the body (Idle at the end). Sets difficulty easy.

checks.note: no husk within 48 blocks: it died, not just wandered out of andy's sight

tests.name: flee-creeper
tests.description: A creeper is summoned 6 blocks from andy; nobody is hurt. Andy must not swing at it (defend only attackers; the defend rules flee a close creeper) and gets away from it (flee-creeper, or the defend model's creeper override) and survives. Sets difficulty easy.

checks.note: he got away from where he stood

tests.name: night-survival
tests.description: Night (time 13000, the daylight cycle stays locked) with two zombies and a skeleton 12-14 blocks from andy, who has an iron sword and 8 bread. For 150 s he only fights mobs that attack him (or flees), eats when he must, and is alive at the end with his sword (a death would drop it). Sets difficulty easy.

checks.note: still has his sword: he did not die

tests.name: hunt-beef
tests.description: Five cows near andy (iron sword, nothing else); chat "andy get 2 beef". The command model routes it to hunt cow beef 2: andy kills cows one at a time and picks up the drops until he has 2 more beef, then frees the body.

tests.name: hunt-none-near
tests.description: No cow within 64 blocks; chat "andy get 2 beef": the hunt finds none near and says the old line ("I couldn't hunt for 2 beef: none near."), then andy is idle.

checks.match: couldn't hunt for 2 beef: none near

tests.name: attack-legacy
tests.description: One pig 4 blocks east of andy (iron sword); !attack("pig") kills it (one kill only) and andy ends idle.

checks.note: no pig within 48 blocks: it died

tests.name: skill-hunt-food
tests.description: 5.5 hunt skill: five cows near andy (iron sword, nothing else); !layaHunt(4) runs the hunt skill job (rules v1 with the hunt task off): approach and attack the nearest cow, pick up the beef, until he has 4 food; laya-hunt.jsonl has the steps.

tests.name: skill-gather-logs
tests.description: 5.5 gather skill: andy with a wooden axe at the base (forest edge); !layaGatherSkill("logs", 6) runs the gather skill job (rules v1): approach the nearest tree (a log with leaves beside it), fell it whole, pick up, until he has 6 wood.

tests.name: skill-place-furnace
tests.description: 5.5 place skill: andy carries a furnace at the base; !layaPlace("furnace") reads the 9×9 grid around the base centre, the place rules v1 pick a cell (next to a station first), and andy places it there: a furnace block near him, none carried.

tests.name: skill-place-torch
tests.description: 5.5 place skill at night: the torch grid is the 7×7 lit sample points (step 3, ±9) around the base centre; at midnight every floor point is dark, so the rules pick the nearest and andy puts one torch on the floor there.
